summary_1line: Rama, Sita, and Lakshmana visit Sage Agastya’s hermitage, receive his hospitality, and Rama is gifted divine weapons forged by Vishwakarma.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama bows at the feet of the radiant sage Agastya, who shines with the brilliance of austerities inside a hermitage filled with tame deer and sacred altars.
Agastya presents Rama with a golden, jewel-encrusted celestial bow, two inexhaustible quivers, a blazing dart, and a silver-sheathed sword.
Rama, Sita, and Lakshmana walk through the hermitage grounds surrounded by deer and numerous altars dedicated to many gods.
